Business Development Resources (BDR), the premier provider of business coaching, training and marketing services for home service contractors across North America, announces the appointment of Ryan Farris as chief executive officer, effective today.

Farris joins BDR with more than 30 years of leadership experience spanning entrepreneurship, technology, marketing and business operations. After more than a decade in corporate leadership, he founded and built his own company before successfully exiting the business.

For the past 10 years, Farris has dedicated his career to partnering with entrepreneurs and small business owners, providing coaching, training and strategic support that helps them create sustainable growth. His experience and passion closely align with BDR's mission of helping home service contractors become "Prime" — the very best they can be in every aspect of their business and leadership.

Business Development Resources (BDR) has appointed Ryan Farris as chief executive officer, marking a leadership transition at the business coaching and training firm serving home service contractors across North America.

Farris assumes the CEO role effective immediately, bringing more than 30 years of leadership experience across entrepreneurship, technology, marketing and business operations. The appointment comes as BDR continues expanding its coaching, training and marketing services for contractors, distributors and platform companies in the home services industry.

Wiseman said selecting a successor was one of the company’s most important long-term decisions, adding that Farris emerged from an extensive search process as the right leader to build on BDR’s culture and mission.
